policy.referenceGeneration: Three research passes read original proposals, prior research and maintainer notes without current engine diagnostics. Consolidation was frozen before current measurement.
policy.accuracyScope: Selected development references, not independent held-out or population accuracy.
policy.unicodeComparison: Exact strings; no normalization, joiner removal or punctuation stripping.
policy.punctuation: Literal Roman periods and supplied spacing are preserved; pipe would produce danda.
policy.digits: Default Devanagari digits outside protected technical spans.
policy.alternatives: Several attested readings can be valid; null preferredReferenceIndex makes no unique-intent or preferred-default claim.
policy.exclude: Do not silently repair malformed Roman inputs, infer missing words, or validate foreign names solely from unverified labels.
policy.sentencePublication: Complete sentence inputs, proposals, references and actual engine strings omitted. Small edits plus hashes reconstruct local references.
